name: How do I claim property damage caused by a government vehicle in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How do I claim property damage caused by a government vehicle in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must file a claim with the City or County Risk Management within six months of the accident, including detailed damage estimates and documentation.sandiego+1​
